feature_extractor: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 global CLS features
strict_protocol_definition: Classifiers and the shared K-Means codebook are fitted using only the balanced few-shot labeled subset. The same selected examples are used by every method.
model_selection: Validation accuracy; official test used only after C selection.
note_on_unlabeled_data: This is the strict labeled-only setting. Reusing a codebook learned from all 45,000 training images would be a separate few-labels-plus-unlabeled-data experiment and is not mixed here.
